title: Daniel Ewing
wikitext:
'''Daniel Ewing''' (born [[March 26]], [[1983]] in [[Missouri City, Texas]]) is a [[basketball]] player for the [[Duke University]] Blue Devils.  He plays the position of guard, usually [[shooting guard]], but he also sometimes plays [[point guard]].  He played for four seasons at Duke, from [[2001]]-[[2005]].  Before coming to Duke, Ewing played for Willowridge High School in [[Houston, Texas]].
